map.📚 深度解析：绝缘材料三项检测判定（耐压/耐温/老化）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Test for Insulating Materials (Voltage / Temp / Aging)
map.绝缘材料进场自检：按耐压、耐温、老化时间三项判定: Insulating material incoming self-check: judge by three items — withstand voltage, withstand temperature, aging time
map.电气安全：耐压与耐温是绝缘根本性能: Electrical safety: withstand voltage and temperature are fundamental insulating properties
map.报告可用性：三项全合格方可用于电气验收: Report usability: all three must pass before electrical acceptance
map.逐项判定：耐压≥10kV、耐温≥200℃、老化时间≥1000h；三项均满足为合格: Item-by-item: withstand voltage ≥ 10 kV, withstand temperature ≥ 200℃, aging time ≥ 1000 h; all three satisfied = pass. Voltage prevents breakdown, temperature prevents thermal degradation, aging time checks durability.
map.耐压 12kV（≥10 ✓）、耐温 220℃（≥200 ✓）、老化 1200h（: Withstand voltage 12 kV (≥10 ✓), temperature 220℃ (≥200 ✓), aging 1200 h (≥1000 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If voltage drops to 8 kV it fails, with breakdown risk.
map.耐压 10kV 怎么理解？: How to understand 10 kV withstand voltage?
map.指在标准条件下材料可承受的工频耐压不低于 10kV 不击穿；实际选型须高于工作电: It means the material can withstand a power-frequency withstand voltage of no less than 10 kV without breakdown under standard conditions; actual selection must exceed the working voltage with margin, stricter in humid environments.
map.老化 1000h 算什么水平？: What level does 1000 h aging represent?
map.约 42 天加速老化，对应中等耐久等级；重要绝缘件常要求更长，须按产品标准与工况: About 42 days of accelerated aging, corresponding to a medium durability grade; important insulating parts often require longer, subject to product standard and service conditions.
map.耐压试验需逐级加压，观察击穿和漏电: Withstand-voltage tests require stepwise pressurization, observing breakdown and leakage
map.耐温试验需长时间高温暴露，检测性能变化: Temperature tests require prolonged high-temperature exposure, checking property changes
map.关于「检测（耐压/耐温/老化）服务」: About the Withstand Voltage / Temperature / Aging Testing Service

Suitable for high-voltage temperature-resistance assessment of electrical insulating materials and wires/cables.
